process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running, because the sandbox could not start: `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. It failed the same way four times in a row, on `gh pr view 226`, `git diff --stat fde86d1e..HEAD`, `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git status`. With no `gh pr diff` and no `git diff`, I could not read PR #226's diff, file list, title or body, or check the head SHA. Subagents run in the same sandbox, so their Bash would fail too.

PR #226 was NOT reviewed. I spawned no reviewers: without the diff they could only guess at the code, and every finding they wrote would be ungrounded and impossible to check for provenance. This record has no findings because the review did not run, not because the PR is clean. Re-run once the runner's sandbox can start (it needs unprivileged user namespaces, or CAP_SYS_ADMIN, for bubblewrap).
